snippet.description:
UPSC Prelims is becoming increasingly unpredictable. Preparing only for familiar questions is no longer enough. You also need to know how to handle unexpected questions, manage lengthy papers and identify what to attempt and what to skip.

That's exactly how Prelims Master Program (PMP) 2027 is evolving its test practice while keeping the focus firmly on conceptual clarity and strong fundamentals.

From practising random questions to building the ability to skip wisely, PMP prepares you for the challenges of the actual UPSC CSE Prelims examination.

Prepare for the predictable. Practise for the unpredictable.

#UPSCPrelims2027 #PMP2027 #UPSCPreparation #UPSCStrategy #UPSCPrelims #LevelUpIAS

Caste and Class are two different forms of social hierarchy, but how do they shape modern Indian society?

In this lecture, understand the differences between caste and class, their relationship, social mobility, caste endogamy, occupational links and the changing nature of social inequalities.

Explore how caste and class influence marriage, banking, politics and economic opportunities in 21st-century India.

An important topic for UPSC GS Paper 1 – Indian Society.
